added_failure_basis: the reviewed run is a diagnostic node with no test arms: its manifest carries no baseline_suite and no after_suite block, and its test_logs name diagnostic gate logs (cpu-stages.log, gpu-stages.log, compare.log, cpu-krylov.log, bin-census.log, cell-census.log, negative-control-reorder.log, negative-control-duplicate.log) rather than suite arms; with no readable arm there is no added failure id to derive, so the count is 0 over an empty id list, not a measured zero over a failing pair. The one log that exits non-zero is cpu-krylov.log, whose EXIT=1 is the node's measurement (two trace stages record non-finite derivatives), not a suite failure.
findings: docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-300-device-carrier.html:89 non-blocking: the worked example for the bin split transposes the coordinate axes — it states the two endpoints of pair 284/291 share R bin 20820480132490 and differ in Z bin (-4495549544932 vs -4495549544931), while bin-census.json records the opposite (R bins 20820480132490 and 20820480132491, both at Z bin -4495549544932); the mechanism and the adjacent-bin claim survive, but the one concrete number a repair node would check against the cited report contradicts the page

docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-300-device-carrier.html:144 non-blocking: the parenthetical '(the 240 interior hexagons are equal to the median within 1e-15 relative, so the rank falls inside a tie)' is carried by no log or json in the run directory and is wrong against the dumped arrays — recomputing from cpu-stages/s2_polygons.npz gives 231 cells within 1e-15 relative of the median (210 exactly equal), not 240; cell-103-census.json records the rank, ratio and z-score the rest of the sentence uses, so only this tie count is unbacked, which is the same defect class the previous review raised at :118

docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-300-device-carrier.html:182 non-blocking: repair site 1 points at nova/biot/plasmagrid.py:394 for PlasmaGrid.loop_neighbour_vertices, but that line is inside tessellate (the Delaunay call); loop_neighbour_vertices is defined at plasmagrid.py:361 and invoked at :410, so a repair node following the pointer opens the wrong function — the mechanism the sentence describes is right, because scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:652 calls it to build the StencilMesh whose stencil MomentGeometry.from_cells receives

justifications.durability: no test file is added (the node's write scope excludes tests); the only durable falsification is the comparator's own --plant mode at scripts/certificate_300_carrier/compare_carrier_stages.py:140-151, recorded in negative-control-reorder.log and negative-control-duplicate.log, and the exit-status behaviour added at compare_carrier_stages.py:210-214 and trace_krylov_action.py:259-263 has no automated assertion behind it
justifications.evidence: the gate's numbers are recorded in compare.log, bin-census.json, cell-103-census.json and cpu-krylov/normalisation_report.json, but two claims in the fragment at certificate-300-device-carrier.html:89 and :144 have no log or report behind them and one of them is wrong against the dumped arrays
justifications.fit: the scripts follow the surrounding diagnostic idiom (argparse, np.load/np.savez, json receipts, Path) as in scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/compare_cached_radial.py; names carry no plan label or version, but the exit contract differs between trace_krylov_action.py:259 (nonzero on a failed stage) and bin_census.py:132 (always zero)
justifications.goal_fidelity: all three done-when items are answered and the prior blocking finding is repaired at docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/certificate-300-device-carrier.html:70-92, but the worked example at :89 transposes which coordinate's bins are the adjacent pair.
justifications.reuse: dump_carrier_stages.py:42 imports the existing build owner scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py instead of rebuilding the carrier, and a search over scripts/ and nova/ for an existing stage-dump or first-differing-stage comparator found only benchmarks/bank_drift_paired_probe.py:77 (paired operand-solve arms) and scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/compare_cached_radial.py (cached radial block), neither of which owns this capability
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff f5500788b..d936af99d lies under scripts/certificate_300_carrier/ or the declared fragment, and nova/ is untouched
